text:
Riley (Events): Quick thread  finalizing registration + post-event flow for next Thurs. Targeting APAC evening slot. Need timezone detection, consent copy, and share-with-a-colleague link.
Ivy (Content): Consent copy approved: 'I consent to being recorded and to receiving follow-up materials from Redwood Inference.' Use canonical string for translations.
Jon (Growth): Add hidden fields: preferred_language and referral_code. UTM template: utm_source={{source}}&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=launchbench_apac.
Priya (Growth): We'll run $300/day paid for two days before. Track referral_code to measure partner uplift. Also push GA4 event on registration complete.
Sam (Ops): Zoom config: cloud recording ON, transcription ON. Prefer vendor captions if creds arrive by Wed EOD; else fallback to Zoom auto captions. Retain recording 90 days.
Maya (Sales Ops): Sales needs attendee CSV 10 mins after session end. Fields: email, company, title, country, referral_code, utm_campaign, attended, watch_seconds, question_flag. If watch_seconds >= 600 OR question_flag==true -> tag MQL & route to Sales.
Ivy (Content): Asset ask: master.mp4, highlight_2min.mp4, cta_45s.mp4, transcript.txt, captions.srt, social_snippets.md (LI + X). Can Ops drop SRT + manifest in S3 path?
Sam (Ops): Yes. We'll write a simple YAML manifest next to assets. Example line: event_id: launchbench-2026-04-xx. We'll output SRT (UTF-8) and plain transcript.txt.
Jon (Growth): Lead routing: POST to /webhooks/webinar with HMAC auth. Primary -> HubSpot incoming webhook; fallback -> Zapier if errors > threshold. Include idempotency key = event_id+email.
Maya (Sales Ops): HubSpot mapping ready. Also want a boolean 'send_to_sales' computed on ingest. If >3 MQLs in 30 mins notify #sales. If >15, create a Slack alert.
Ivy (Content): Follow-up email drafted: subject 'Thanks  replay + highlights' body 1-sentence + highlight clip + 3 CTAs (Watch replay / Book demo / Download brief). Add UTM per CTA.
Priya (Growth): Add GA4 push on CTA clicks: event_name=webinar_cta_click, params={cta_type,event_id,campaign}. Use dataLayer pushes.
Sam (Ops): Sample webhook CSV we'll emit: email,attended,watch_seconds,utm_campaign,referral_code,question_flag
jane@acme.com,true,812,launchbench_apac,REF42,false
Ivy (Content): Caption QC: Content will QA a 3-min sample within 24h and flag issues. If vendor captions are poor, Ops will re-request timestamps from vendor.
Sam (Ops): Caption vendor note: need creds by Wed EOD. If missing, fallback to Zoom autosub and generate SRT internally.
Riley (Events): Reminders: 24h and 1h before in attendee timezone. Confirmation page should include 'share with colleague' prefilled message and referral_code param.
Maya (Sales Ops): Sales prep: 20-min playbook + top 10 Qs doc. I'll schedule a 20-min briefing 48h out once registrations hit 20.
Jon (Growth): One more: expose a 'preferred_time' select for registrants to choose APAC-evening vs PST-morning; helps with reminder routing.
CaptionBot: Vendor captions received and queued.
Sam (Ops): Action items: implement webhook + HMAC, drop manifest to S3, output SRT and transcript, emit test payload here.
Ivy (Content): I'll upload social snippets + speaker quote when assets are live.
Riley (Events): Lock registration page by 6pm PT today and run an E2E test tomorrow 10am PT. If vendor creds not in by Wed EOD we fallback to Zoom captions and Zapier routing. Closing thread after successful test. :white_check_mark:
